details: The U.S. Treasury Department sanctioned multiple cryptocurrency wallets linked to Iran, leading to the freeze of $344 million in digital assets. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated this action aims to target financial lifelines connected to the Iranian regime.
title: US Sanctions Iran-Tied Crypto Wallets, Freezing $344 Million

details: An ECB board member, Kazimir, indicated that the ongoing Iran war could necessitate a slight interest rate increase by the European Central Bank due to rising inflationary pressures. This reflects a hawkish stance, with market probabilities for significant rate cuts remaining very low in the near term.
title: ECB Signals Potential Rate Hike Amid Inflation

details: Japan's core inflation accelerated to 1.8% in March, marking the first monthly increase in five months. This economic data, combined with ongoing geopolitical instability, has contributed to Bitcoin consolidating around the $77,800 level and exhibiting weakening upward momentum.
title: Japan Inflation Rises; Bitcoin Loses Upward Momentum

details: The U.S. annual inflation rate surged to 3.3% in March 2026, reaching its highest level since 2024. This increase is largely attributed to geopolitical instability and rising energy costs. The Federal Reserve is widely anticipated to maintain its current interest rates, holding them steady at 3.5%–3.75% during its upcoming April meeting.
title: US Inflation Jumps to 3.3% in March; Fed Expected to Hold Rates

details: Bitcoin spot exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have experienced a strong performance, recording eight consecutive days of net inflows through April 23, accumulating a total of $2.43 billion in April alone. BlackRock's IBIT has been a primary driver, pushing its total Bitcoin holdings above 800,000 BTC, signaling robust institutional demand.
title: Bitcoin Spot ETFs Record Eight Days of Inflows, IBIT Leads

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has revised its 2026 global growth forecast downwards to 3.1% from 3.4%. The institution issued a warning about increased recession risks, particularly if the US-Iran war continues to escalate, suggesting a fragile macroeconomic environment that could negatively impact digital assets.
title: IMF Cuts Global Growth Forecast, Warns of Recession Risk

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) has signed agreements with three European payment standardization organizations to integrate existing open payment standards for digital euro transactions. This move aims to reduce implementation costs for banks, merchants, and payment service providers, with a potential first issuance targeting 2029.
title: ECB Advances Digital Euro with Payment Standard Agreements

details: New proposed exchange control regulations in South Africa would classify Bitcoin as 'capital,' requiring explicit permission from the Reserve Bank for any cross-border transactions. Critics argue these stringent rules could lead to the criminalization of self-custody and significantly restrict crypto users' financial freedom.
title: South Africa Considers Tightening Crypto Exchange Regulations

details: Nasdaq is moving forward with plans to integrate tokenized shares into its existing market infrastructure, with a focus on preserving shareholder rights. This initiative reflects a broader trend of traditional financial markets exploring blockchain technology, with the success dependent on delivering tangible value beyond current market offerings.
title: Nasdaq Plans Integration of Tokenized Shares into Market

details: Visa is enhancing its engagement with blockchain technology by launching a validator node on the Tempo network. This strategic move aims to support on-chain payments and stablecoin settlement, signaling a deeper integration into blockchain-enabled financial services infrastructure.
title: Visa Launches Validator Node on Tempo Network for On-Chain Payments
